title: Viavo for press
lead: Viavo is a tap-to-talk AI voice assistant for drivers on iPhone and CarPlay. Press one button on the car screen, say what you need in your own words, and Viavo does it and answers out loud, with a native voice, in 28 languages.
why: Siri on CarPlay still doesn’t speak Polish, Czech, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Croatian, Serbian or Ukrainian. Drivers there either talk to their car in English or don’t talk to it at all. The chatbot apps that came to CarPlay mostly talk: in ZDNET’s test, ChatGPT and Perplexity couldn’t place a call, send a message or play music. Viavo speaks all of these languages and twenty more, understands everyday speech rather than fixed commands, and does the task.
Viavo is made by a small team in Serbia.
says: Take me home, with a stop for gas
The route opens in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.
A good restaurant on the way, in about an hour
Places with ratings, opening hours and reviews.
Will I make it by nine?
Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music or Deezer; live radio by name.
The gist of Telegram and Slack, read a message, dictate a reply; WhatsApp and SMS messages open ready to send.
Remind me to call the bank when I get to the office
saysNote: And any question, with a web search for fresh facts.
facts: 28, a native female or male voice in each
Polish, Czech, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Croatian, Serbian, Ukrainian
Free to try: 10 free credits, then a free week of Viavo Plus (monthly or yearly subscription)
